**规则**
主题句提出观点后，必须用具体、相关的材料回答“凭什么这么说？”。常见支撑有三类：①事实或数据；②具体例子（有人物、地点、情境或结果）；③清楚的推理（A 导致 B，B 又导致 C）。支撑句必须直接服务于主题句，不能只是换个说法重复观点，也不能讲相邻但不同的话题。

**例子**
- ✗ Online learning is convenient. It is very convenient for many people.
  ✓ Online learning is convenient. A nurse who works night shifts, for example, can watch recorded lectures in the morning instead of missing classes.
- ✗ Cities should improve public transport because it is very important.
  ✓ Cities should improve public transport because a single full bus can take dozens of cars off the road during rush hour.
- ✗ As the saying goes, practice makes perfect, so homework is useful.
  ✓ Homework is useful because it makes students apply new rules on their own, which shows them what they have not yet understood.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 用名言、俗语或“众所周知”代替证据（As the saying goes… / As we all know…）。
2. 同义反复：支撑句只是把主题句换个词再说一遍。
3. 例子过于空泛（many people, some countries），读者想象不出具体画面。

**自查方法**
读完每个支撑句问两件事：“读者能想象出一个具体的人、场景或数字吗？”“删掉这句后，论点是否就少了一个理由？”如果删掉也无所谓，它就不是真正的支撑。

**补充**
- **不具名的“专家”和“高级词汇式”改写都不是证据**：Experts say… / Scientists all agree… 没有来源也没有内容，和“众所周知”一样空洞；用 In other words 加高级词汇把主题句换个说法，仍然是同义反复。
  ✗ Experts say that walking is good for older people.
  ✓ Walking every day keeps older people's muscles strong and their joints flexible, which lowers their risk of falling.
- **证据之后要写“解释”**：摆出事实或数据后，用 This means that… / As a result… 说明它如何证明论点，不要直接跳到 This shows that … is very important 或 Clearly…。
  （Claim: Tablets can keep pupils' learning materials up to date.）
  ✗ Printed textbooks are usually revised only once every few years. This shows that tablets are very important.
  ✓ Printed textbooks are usually revised only once every few years. On tablets, however, schools can update materials overnight, which means that pupils can always work with the latest information.
- **警惕“相近但不同”的论点**：证明“问题很严重”不等于证明“这个办法有效”；证明“人们感觉更好”不等于证明“事实上更好”；列出另一个好处，不等于证明主题句说的那个好处。
  （Claim: Cooking lessons at school help teenagers eat more healthily.）
  ✗ Many teenagers eat too much fast food.（只证明问题存在）
  ✓ Teenagers who can cook a few simple meals are less likely to rely on takeaways when their parents are not at home.
- **一个人的经历不能单独证明普遍结论**：只用“我爷爷/我表弟”一个人的经历，再写 This proves that … for everyone，属于以偏概全。个人例子可以作补充，但要配合普遍性的理由，结论也要有分寸（can / some / suggests，而不是 always / everyone / proves）。
  ✗ My cousin plays chess every day and gets top marks, which proves that chess makes all children better at maths.
  ✓ Chess requires players to plan several moves ahead, so regular players practise the same step-by-step thinking that maths problems demand.
evidence_quality:
**规则**
好论据要同时满足三点：①相关——直接证明“这个”论点，而不是相邻话题；②充分——一个孤例不能证明 most / always 这样的普遍结论；③可信——来源清楚、可核实，不是道听途说或来历不明的精确数字。还要分清四类材料：事实/数据、有代表性的例子、个人经历、假设（If… would… / Imagine…）。个人经历和假设只能作补充，不能单独撑起普遍结论。

**例子**
- ✗ My cousin became rich without a degree, so university is a waste of time.
  ✓ Although some people succeed without a degree, employment figures in many countries show that graduates, on average, earn more and are less likely to be unemployed.
- ✗ Studies show that video games are bad.
  ✓ Several studies of teenagers' sleep have found that playing video games late at night is linked to going to bed later and sleeping less.
- ✗ Imagine a city without cars: everyone would be healthy and happy.
  ✓ After Madrid restricted car access to its city centre in 2018, levels of nitrogen dioxide in the area fell noticeably.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 用“my friend / my cousin”一个人的经历证明“most people”。
2. 写 Studies show / Experts say 却不说明是什么研究、具体发现了什么（能写出机构或年份更好），或编造过分精确的数字（如 87.3%）。
3. 例子跑题：例子讲的是 A，论点讲的是 B。

**自查方法**
给每条论据贴标签（事实/例子/经历/假设），再问三个问题：它证明的正是我的论点吗？它的分量配得上我用的 most / always 吗？一个持怀疑态度的读者会相信这个来源吗？

**补充**
- **名言、名人、投票和“自古以来”都不是证据**：它们只说明有人这么想，不能证明事实，最多用来引出话题。✗ As the old saying goes, 'An apple a day keeps the doctor away,' so eating fruit is the best way to stay healthy. ✓ Large studies of adults' diets have found that people who eat more fruit and vegetables tend to have a lower risk of heart disease.
- **看来源是否独立、方法是否可靠**：卖产品的公司、它资助的研究、广告和自愿留下的好评都可能有偏差；独立、有对照组的研究更可信。数字精确、评论很多都不能弥补来源问题。✗ A toothpaste brand's own advertisement says that its new formula makes teeth 50 percent stronger. ✓ Researchers with no link to the company compared children who used the new toothpaste with children who used an ordinary one.
- **相关不等于因果**：两件事经常一起出现，可能是第三个因素（如家庭收入、父母受教育程度）同时造成的；证据写 tend to，结论就不能写 makes / causes。✗ Children who grow up in homes with many books get higher marks, so buying books makes children cleverer. ✓ Children who grow up in homes with many books tend to get higher marks, although their parents' education may partly explain this link.
- **人数多不等于有代表性**：只调查某一类人，不能推出“公众”的看法。✗ More than 2,000 gym members said that exercise was the most important part of their week, so most people see exercise as a top priority. ✓ Most of the gym members surveyed said that exercise was an important part of their week.
- **结论的范围和时间要与证据一致**：一所学校、一个学期的数据不能推出“每所学校、很多年”。✗ One school's test scores rose in the term after it gave every pupil a tablet, so tablets will raise results in every school for years to come. ✓ One school's early results suggest that tablets may help some pupils, but longer studies in more schools are needed.
- **证明问题严重 ≠ 证明对策有效**：对策类论点需要“这个办法确实有效”的证据；说 the most effective 还需要与其他办法比较。✗ Many elderly people fall at home, and falls can cause serious injuries, so free balance classes are the most effective solution. ✓ In several trials, older people who took regular balance and strength classes fell less often than those who did not.
- **Suppose… / Imagine… 引出的人物和场景是假想的**：后面一连串 would 再通顺也只是推测，不是真实例子。✗ Suppose a city made all its buses free; everyone would leave their cars at home, so every city should do the same. ✓ After one European capital made public transport free for its residents, passenger numbers rose, but car traffic fell only slightly.
analysis:
**规则**
论据不会自己说话。在例子或数据之后，要用 1-2 句“分析”说明它为什么、如何证明论点——这就是连接论据与论点的推理桥梁（warrant）。常用信号：This shows that… / This is because… / As a result,… / …, which means that… / In other words,…。好的分析要讲出例子背后的机制（原因→过程→结果），并回扣主题句；不能只复述例子，也不能直接跳到新观点或口号。

**例子**
- ✗ Finland gives teachers a lot of freedom. Therefore, Finnish education is successful.
  ✓ Finland gives teachers a lot of freedom in planning lessons. This matters because teachers who know their pupils well can adjust the pace and content to their needs, which keeps weaker learners from falling behind.
- ✗ Many young people use shared bikes. This shows that many young people use shared bikes.
  ✓ Many young people use shared bikes for short trips. This suggests that when cycling is cheap and convenient, people choose it instead of taking a taxi or a car, which could ease traffic in city centres.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 例子后直接写 So… 跳到结论，中间推理全靠读者脑补。
2. This shows… 后面只是把例子重说一遍，没有新信息。
3. 用 It is obvious that… / There is no doubt that… 代替解释。

**自查方法**
在每个例子后面问一句“So what？这为什么能证明我的观点？”，把答案写成一个由 because 或 which means 引出的句子。如果写不出来，说明这个例子可能选得不对。

**补充**
- **有信号词 ≠ 有分析**：This is because / This shows that 后面必须给出新信息（原因→过程→结果），而不是“很重要”“人人都知道”、赞美或口号（如“科学家是英雄，我们应该尊重他们”）。
  ✗ Many offices now offer standing desks. This is because health is very important, and everyone knows that sitting is bad.
  ✓ Many offices now offer standing desks. This is because changing position during the day can reduce back pain, so staff may be able to work comfortably for longer.
- **紧扣主题句的具体焦点**：分析说的“好处”必须正是主题句要证明的那一个，不能换成与话题相关的其他万能理由（环保、健康、经济、旅游）；特别注意主题句中限定焦点的词（如 employers, in the long run, social skills）。
  ✗ (Topic: Learning to cook makes teenagers more independent.) This shows that cooking at home is cheaper than eating in restaurants.
  ✓ This means that they no longer depend on their parents or takeaways for every meal, which prepares them to live on their own.
- **不要从一个例子推出“所有/必然”**：一个城市、一次试验最多“表明”某事“可能”成立。多用 suggests / may / can / some / in many cases，避免 proves / always / every / all / eliminate。
  ✗ One village banned cars and its air became cleaner. This proves that banning cars will solve air pollution in every city.
  ✓ This suggests that reducing car traffic can noticeably improve air quality, especially in places where people can easily walk or cycle instead.
- **相关 ≠ 因果**：研究只发现“A 和 B 同时出现”时，分析要提出合理机制并加限定语，必要时承认其他解释（如家庭条件等第三因素，或因果方向相反）。承认局限之后，用 Even so 等让步连接回扣论点，不要用 therefore 把“只是相关”直接推成“因此有因果作用”。
  ✗ Students who sleep more get higher grades. This proves that sleep causes good grades.
  ✓ This may be because well-rested students can concentrate for longer in class, although other factors, such as a calmer home life, may also explain part of the link.
counterargument:
**规则**
有说服力的议论文会主动处理反方观点，通常分三步：①公正陈述反方（Some people argue that… / Critics claim that…），不歪曲、不嘲讽；②适当让步，承认其合理之处（Admittedly,… / It is true that… / While this may be true in some cases,…）；③有理有据地反驳（However,… because… / This argument overlooks…），给出理由或证据，最后回到自己的立场。反驳不是简单一句“他们错了”，让步也不能承认对方的整体结论。

**例子**
- ✗ Some foolish people think homework is useless, but they are totally wrong.
  ✓ Some people argue that homework takes away time for rest. While too much homework can indeed be harmful, a moderate amount helps students review what they have learned and learn to work independently.
- ✗ Although tourism brings money, but it is bad for local people.
  ✓ Although tourism brings money to an area, much of it often goes to large hotel chains rather than to local residents.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 稻草人：把反方写得很蠢（some stupid people think…），反驳因此毫无说服力。
2. 只让步不反驳，或反驳只有一句 I don't agree，没有理由。
3. 受汉语“虽然……但是……”影响，写成 Although…, but…。

**自查方法**
检查反方段落是否三件齐全：反方观点（谁认为什么、为什么）+ 让步信号（admittedly / it is true）+ 反驳（however + 理由/证据）。再问：持反方观点的人读了，会觉得自己被公正地描述了吗？

**补充**
- **反驳要对题**：反驳必须回应反方的核心理由，不能换个话题列举己方的其他好处，也不能攻击持反方观点的人（人身攻击）。✗ Critics say a four-day week would lower productivity. However, workers would be happier. ✓ However, in several trials, staff finished the same amount of work in four days, partly because meetings were shorter.
- **隐蔽的稻草人**：措辞中立也可能不公正。把对方动机写得很琐碎，或把对方主张夸大到极端，都是歪曲。应该呈现反方最有力的理由。✗ Opponents seem to believe that companies should be free to tell children lies. ✓ Opponents argue that advertising pays for many children's programmes.
- **证据要可靠**：一个人的经历或“很多人都这样做”证明不了普遍结论；少用 clearly proves，多用 suggests。✗ My best friend plays basketball every day and still came top in maths, which clearly proves that exercise does not harm grades. ✓ Many schools that have added daily PE report no fall in exam results.
- **让步不能交出核心论点**：不能承认作者最需要否认的那一点；结尾也不能否认已让步的事实、倒向反方或含糊不表态，最后一句要回到立场。✗ Admittedly, community service rarely changes young offenders' behaviour. However, it is cheaper. ✓ Admittedly, community service is a milder punishment than prison. However, a milder punishment is not necessarily a less effective one.
- **转折衔接词**：让步后用 However / Nevertheless / Even so 引出反驳。On the contrary 只用来否定前一句（“恰恰相反”），Besides / In addition 表示递进，它们都不能引出反驳。✗ It is true that the tax raises prices. On the contrary, the extra cost is small. ✓ It is true that the tax raises prices. However, the extra cost is small.
- **Despite / In spite of 是介词**，后面接名词或动名词；让步内容放进 Although / While 从句，作者观点放在主句。✗ Despite games are addictive, many teach teamwork. ✓ Despite the risk of addiction, many games teach teamwork. ✓ Although video games can be addictive, many of them teach teamwork.
critical_questions:
**规则**
写作和审稿时，用几个关键问题检查论证漏洞：①代表性——这个例子或样本能代表整体吗？②因果——A 和 B 同时出现，就一定是 A 导致 B 吗？会不会是 B 导致 A（反向因果）？③其他解释——有没有第三个因素同时影响两者，或只是巧合？④类比——两种情况在关键方面真的可比吗？⑤结论范围——是否用了 all / always / the only 等过度概括？发现漏洞后，要么补充证据，要么用 may / tend to / in many cases 限定结论。

**例子**
- ✗ Countries with more smartphones have higher obesity rates, so smartphones cause obesity.
  ✓ Countries with more smartphones also tend to be richer, and wealth affects both phone ownership and diet, so more evidence is needed before we can say that smartphones cause obesity.
- ✗ My school banned phones and our grades went up, so banning phones always improves grades.
  ✓ At my school, grades rose after phones were banned, which suggests that a ban may help, although other changes that year could also have played a role.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 把“相关”写成“导致”（lead to / cause），忽略第三因素。
2. 用一个人、一个城市的情况推出 all people / every country。
3. 只找支持自己的例子，从不问“有没有反例？”

**自查方法**
写完一个论证后，假装自己是反方，依次追问：“样本够不够、有没有代表性？是巧合还是另有原因？因果方向会不会反了？有没有反例？”至少回答其中一个问题，并相应补充证据或加上限定词。

**补充**
- **⑥来源**——提供证据的人或机构会不会从结论中获利？有利益冲突的证据不一定错，但需要独立研究（independent research）来核实；只强调来源“名气大”，或再找一个同样有利益关系的来源，都不能解决问题。
  ✗ A report by a fast-food chain proves that its burgers are a healthy choice.
  ✓ A report funded by a fast-food chain claims that its burgers can be a healthy choice, but independent research is needed to confirm this.
- **偏差样本与自我选择**：只在本来就感兴趣的人聚集的地方做调查（如某个场所门口），或只统计主动回复的人，结果会偏向一方。
  ✗ Ninety percent of visitors to a science museum said they enjoy science, so most people love science.
  ✓ Most visitors to a science museum say they enjoy science, but museum visitors are probably more interested in science than the general public.
- **只看成功者（幸存者偏差，survivorship bias）**：只列举做了某事并成功的人时，要追问：有多少人做了同样的事却没有成功？
  ✗ Several famous business people left university early, so leaving university early is a good way to become rich.
  ✓ A few famous business people succeeded without a degree, but many people who leave university early never become rich, so their cases are probably not typical.
- **反向因果的常用问法**：Could it be that B causes A, rather than the other way round?
  ✗ People who visit the dentist often have more tooth problems, so visiting the dentist harms your teeth.
  ✓ People with tooth problems are more likely to visit the dentist, so the link may run the other way.
- **指出第三因素要具体**：点名是什么因素 + 说明它如何同时影响两者 + 提出检验方法（比较条件相似的两组 / 在分析中控制该因素 / 随机实验）。
  ✗ There may be other factors.
  ✓ Higher income could explain both, so researchers should compare people with similar incomes.
- **随机对照试验（randomised trial）**基本排除了第三因素和自我选择，这时要检查的是：结论有没有超出研究实际比较的内容（如从“有效”跳到“唯一有效”）。
  ✗ The trial shows that walking groups are the only way to improve mood.
  ✓ The trial shows that walking groups can improve mood.
- **检验类比要找“与结论相关”的关键差异**，而不是随便哪一个差异。例如论证：Self-service checkouts work well in supermarkets, so pharmacies should use them for all medicines.
  ✗（无关差异）Pharmacies are usually smaller than supermarkets.
  ✓（关键差异）Unlike groceries, many medicines should only be sold with a pharmacist's advice.
- **回应批判性问题的常见错误**：加强语气（definitely, beyond doubt）、扩大结论、转移话题。正确做法：承认问题 + 用 may / suggests 限定结论 + 说明还需要什么证据。
examiner:
**规则**
当考官时，先按评分标准（如雅思大作文四项：Task Response 任务回应、Coherence and Cohesion 连贯与衔接、Lexical Resource 词汇、Grammatical Range and Accuracy 语法）通读，再找出“最影响得分的那个问题”。四项分数权重相同，但不同问题的杀伤力差别很大：跑题、漏答题目的一部分或立场前后矛盾，会让任务回应分被严重压低。因此检查顺序通常是：是否回应题目每一部分、立场是否清楚一致 > 论点是否有解释和例子 > 段落逻辑与衔接 > 词汇和语法的准确性。偶尔一两个小语法错误，远不如跑题、漏答、立场矛盾或“只有观点没有论证”严重。

**例子**
- ✗ This paragraph is bad because it has a spelling mistake.
  ✓ The main problem is that the paragraph does not answer the question: the task asks how to solve the problem, but the writer only describes its causes.
- ✗ Good paragraph, because it uses many linking words.
  ✓ Although the paragraph uses many linking words, several are used incorrectly, such as 'Moreover' before a contrasting idea, which makes the logic hard to follow.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 只盯语法和拼写，忽视跑题、漏答题目要求这类“大问题”。
2. 以为连接词越多、单词越难，分数就越高。
3. 把万能模板句（With the development of society…）当成高分特征。

**自查方法**
按顺序问四个问题，在第一个答“否”的地方停下——那通常就是最主要的问题：①回答了题目的每一部分吗？②立场清楚且前后一致吗？③每个论点都有解释和例子吗？④段落读起来逻辑顺畅吗？然后才看词汇和语法。

**补充**
- **审题看限定词**：题目中的限定对象或条件（如 on city centres、at primary school or secondary school、governments or individuals）决定讨论焦点；话题对而焦点错，或只是重复题目关键词，也算没有回应题目。✗ Task asks about effects on city centres → Home workers save time on commuting. ✓ As fewer people commute, many city-centre cafés and shops lose customers.
- **双方观点都要真正“讨论”**：Discuss both views 题中，对方观点只用一句 Some people think… 带过就否定，只算部分完成任务。✗ Admittedly, some people think that other measures are needed. Nevertheless, … ✓ Others argue that poor diet is the main problem, so taxing sugary drinks would be more effective.
- **同意程度要前后一致**：同意/不同意题必须表态，不能只写“有利有弊、因人而异”；论点句写 partly agree，后文就必须写出不同意的部分；结论不能推翻论点句。✗ In conclusion, different people will have different views. ✓ Overall, I disagree, because many essential services could not operate on a four-day week.
- **例子要对准论点，证据要配得上结论**：例子只和话题有关、却证明不了论点，或用一两次个人经历推出 always / everyone 式的结论，都属于论证薄弱。个人经历本身可以用。✗ Two bad online orders prove that online products are always worse. ✓ Products bought online can sometimes be of lower quality than expected.
- **深度胜过数量**：一段罗列七个一句话的理由，不如把一两个理由按“观点—解释—例子”充分展开。
- **段落统一、指代清楚**：一段只讲一个中心，不要顺着联想跑到别的话题；几个复数名词同时出现时，不要连续用 they / this，必要时重复名词。✗ They also claim that this view is short-sighted. ✓ Supporters, in turn, argue that this view is short-sighted.
- **简单准确不是大问题**：用词简单但准确、论证完整的段落是好段落；一两个拼写或冠词小错只会略微影响语言分，不要因此忽略内容上的大问题。
hedging:
**规则**
学术议论文中，没有确凿证据时不要用 always / never / all / everyone / prove / definitely 等绝对化表达，而要用限定语（hedges）让结论与证据强度相符：
- 情态动词：may, might, can, could
- 动词：tend to, appear to, seem to, suggest, indicate
- 副词：often, generally, arguably, probably, largely
- 范围词：many, some, in many cases, to some extent
限定要适度：一个论断通常用一到两个限定手段就够（如 can + some），叠加三四个会让观点消失；已被充分证实的事实不需要限定。

**例子**
- ✗ Online learning is always less effective than classroom teaching. → ✓ Online learning tends to be less effective than classroom teaching for young children.
- ✗ This proves that social media destroys teenagers' mental health. → ✓ This suggests that heavy social media use may harm teenagers' mental health.
- ✗ It is possible that this might perhaps help to some extent. → ✓ This may help in some cases.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 把“一定”“肯定”“所有人都”直译成 definitely / must / everyone，造成过度概括。
2. 用口语化的 Maybe 开头代替学术限定（✗ Maybe it is harmful. ✓ It may be harmful.）。
3. 过度限定：may possibly perhaps 叠加，连 thesis 都含糊不清。

**自查方法**
圈出 all / every / always / never / must / prove / definitely，问自己：“有没有反例？我的证据够强吗？”有反例就改为 many / often / tend to / suggest / may；同时检查是否在一句话里叠加了三个或更多限定词。

**补充**
- **报告动词与因果动词要与证据匹配**：prove / demonstrate > show > suggest / indicate；问卷、观察等只能说明相关，用 be linked to / be associated with，不用 cause / lead to。✗ This survey proves that eating breakfast leads to better concentration. ✓ This survey suggests that eating breakfast may be linked to better concentration.
- **单一措施的效果不要说成“彻底解决”**：用 help to reduce / contribute to 代替 solve / cure / eliminate。✗ Free school meals will definitely eliminate child poverty. ✓ Free school meals could help to reduce child poverty.
- **预测未来不用 must**：must 表示义务或对现状的推断；表示“很可能”用 be likely to / will probably / could。✗ Food prices must rise next year. ✓ Food prices are likely to rise next year.
- **强化词（boosters）同样需要证据**：undoubtedly, surely, of course, no one can deny, be bound to 和 always / all 一样容易被反驳。
- **限定要加在“说过头”的地方**：只在别处加 perhaps / it seems 或 may，而保留 every / nobody / the main cause，问题并没有解决。✗ Perhaps every teenager owns a smartphone. ✓ Most teenagers now own a smartphone. ✗ Video games may be the main cause of poor grades. ✓ Video games appear to be one of several factors linked to poor grades.
- **口语 / 主观限定换成学术限定**：I think / I guess / maybe / kind of / In my personal opinion, I think → may, can, arguably, it could be argued that。✗ I guess fast food is kind of unhealthy. ✓ Fast food can be unhealthy. / ✓ Fast food is arguably unhealthy.
- **有可靠来源的数据直接陈述**：✗ According to official figures, sales may possibly have doubled. ✓ According to official figures, sales doubled.
- **限定表达的语法**：tend 是实义动词，✗ are tend to be / tend to being ✓ tend to be；be likely to + 动词原形，或 It is likely that + 从句；maybe（副词）≠ may be（情态动词 + be）：✗ This maybe caused by stress. ✓ This may be caused by stress.
paraphrase:
**规则**
同义改写（paraphrasing）要在保持原意的前提下，同时改变“词”和“结构”：
1. 换词：用同义词或近义表达，但要确认搭配地道；专业术语和无法替换的关键词（如 primary school, government）可以保留。
2. 换结构：动词↔名词（improve → improvement）、主动↔被动、从句↔短语（If cities improve public transport → Better public transport）、换主语。
3. 保分寸：不能改变原句的范围（some / all）、确定程度（could / will）和立场（argue / prove）。
只换一两个词或整句照抄都不算改写。

**例子**
- 题目：Some people think that university education should be free. ✗ Nowadays, some people think that university education should be free.（照抄） → ✓ It is sometimes argued that higher education should be provided at no cost to students.
- ✗ Air pollution has become a heavy problem in many big cities.（逐词替换，搭配错误） → ✓ Poor air quality is now a pressing concern in many major cities.
- 原句：Some experts say it could help. ✗ Experts have proven that it helps.（改变分寸） → ✓ According to some specialists, it might be beneficial.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 引言直接照抄题目，只在前面加 Nowadays 或 With the development of society。
2. 查词典逐词替换，造成 heavy problem、youthful persons 这类不自然搭配。
3. 改写时改了意思：some → most，should → must，could → will。

**自查方法**
把改写句和原句并排比较：①出现连续 4 个或更多相同单词（术语除外）就重写；②核对“谁、做什么、范围多大、多确定”是否都没变；③不确定的同义词搭配，宁可改用结构变化。

**补充**
- **换词先查“主语”和搭配**：price / cost / fee 只说 high / low，物品或服务本身才说 expensive / cheap；effect / influence 用 have 搭配，程度用 strong / powerful / significant。✗ University fees are too expensive. → ✓ University fees are too high. / ✓ A university education is too expensive. ✗ Television makes a heavy influence on children. → ✓ Television has a strong influence on children.
- **形近词不一定同义**：economic（与经济、经济学有关的，如 economic growth）≠ economical（省钱的、不浪费的）。✗ Buying second-hand furniture is an economic choice. → ✓ Buying second-hand furniture is an economical choice.
- **术语照用，不要按中文自造**：原文中的固定术语（renewable energy、climate change、primary school 等）可以直接保留；按中文字面自造，只会得到英语中不存在的说法。✗ recyclable energy（“可再生能源”的误译）→ ✓ renewable energy
- **保留逻辑关系和全部信息**：让步（although / while）不能改成因果（so / because）；“没有 A 就可能 B”既不等于“出现 B 的人大多没有 A”，也不等于“有 A 就一定没有 B”；双方观点题两方都要写，不能添加题目没有的理由。原句：Although online shopping is convenient, it reduces face-to-face contact. ✗ Online shopping is convenient, so it reduces face-to-face contact.（让步变因果）→ ✓ While shopping online is convenient, it also cuts down on face-to-face interaction.
- **名词化作主语 + 因果动词**：把原因从句变成名词短语作主语，用 lead sb to do / drive sb to do / lead to + 名词 连接结果；注意 make sb do，不说 make sb to do。原句：Many students take part-time jobs because they need extra money. ✗ Many students do part-time work because they require additional money.（只换词）→ ✓ The need for extra income leads many students to take on part-time work.
transitions:
**规则**
先判断两句之间的逻辑关系，再选连接词，并注意它的语法类型：
- 转折/对比：however, in contrast, whereas, on the other hand（对比相反的两面）
- 让步：although / even though + 从句；despite / in spite of + 名词或动名词；nevertheless
- 因果：because + 从句；because of / due to + 名词；therefore, as a result, consequently
- 递进：moreover, furthermore, in addition
- 举例：for example, for instance
however / therefore / moreover 是副词，不能像 but / and 那样用逗号连接两个完整句子，要用句号或分号。although 与 but 不能同时使用。连接词贵在准确，不必每句都加。

**例子**
- ✗ Although online courses are cheap, but they lack interaction. → ✓ Although online courses are cheap, they lack interaction.
- ✗ Cars pollute the air, however, many people still drive. → ✓ Cars pollute the air; however, many people still drive.
- ✗ Despite the rent is high, many graduates stay in Shanghai. → ✓ Despite the high rent, many graduates stay in Shanghai.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. “虽然……但是……”直译为 although...but；“因为……所以……”直译为 because...so。
2. 把 however 当连词，用逗号连接两个句子。
3. 用 on the other hand 表示“另外”，用 on the contrary 表示“相比之下”。

**自查方法**
给每个连接词标出它连接的两句之间的关系（对比/让步/因果/递进/举例），确认关系对得上；再看它后面接的是句子还是名词，以及前面的标点是否正确。

**补充**
- 不要叠用连接词：although … but、although … however、but however、because … so、so therefore 都是重复。✗ The bus is cheap, but however, it is slow. → ✓ The bus is cheap, but it is slow. ✗ Because it rained, so the game was cancelled. → ✓ Because it rained, the game was cancelled. / ✓ It rained, so the game was cancelled.
- 用逗号连接两个独立的句子时，中间必须有 and / but / or / so / yet 等并列连词（或者用 although / because 等从属连词引导其中一句）；however / nevertheless / therefore / consequently 是副词，前面要用分号或句号。✗ Prices rose, nevertheless sales grew. → ✓ Prices rose; nevertheless, sales grew. / ✓ Prices rose, but sales grew.
- 分清因果方向：This is because / because 引出原因；This is why / As a result / Therefore 引出结果。✗ The roads were icy this morning. This is why it snowed heavily last night. → ✓ The roads were icy this morning. This is because it snowed heavily last night.
- due to / because of / owing to 和 despite / in spite of 一样是介词（短语），后面接名词或动名词；要接从句，就用 because / as / since / although，或 due to the fact that / despite the fact that。也不要写 despite of。✗ Due to the bridge was closed, … → ✓ Because the bridge was closed, … / ✓ Due to the closure of the bridge, …
- even though + 事实；even if + 假设（常和 were / would 搭配）。✗ Even though tickets were free, many people would still stay at home. → ✓ Even if tickets were free, many people would still stay at home.
- on the contrary 用来否定前面的说法（常跟在否定句后），引出“恰恰相反”的事实；比较两个不同对象用 in contrast / by contrast / on the other hand，或用 whereas / while 合并两句。✓ The plan did not save money. On the contrary, it cost more. ✓ City flats are small, whereas country houses are spacious.
- 让步—反驳结构：Admittedly / It is true that …（先承认对方的理由）→ However, …（回到自己的立场）。While 表示让步时相当于 although，主句前不能再加 but。
- 段落衔接不只靠连接词：用 this / such + 名词（this problem, such machines）回指上一句；in turn 表示因果链的下一环（A 导致 B，B 进而导致 C），不能当作一般的“另外”使用。
referencing:
**规则**
用指代和词汇链把句子连成连贯的段落：
1. this / these / such + 概括名词（this policy, these measures, such an approach）回指前一句描述的整件事，比单独用 it 或含义模糊的 this 更清楚。
2. 代词（it, they, them）必须有唯一、明确的先行词，并且单复数一致；先行词离得远或中间有其他名词时，改用名词。
3. 词汇链：第一次用全称，之后用代词、同义词或上位词（electric cars → these vehicles → they），避免机械重复。
概括名词要选对类别：做法用 policy / practice / measure，问题用 issue / problem，趋势用 trend。

**例子**
- ✗ Many cities have banned cars from their centres. It has reduced both noise and air pollution.（It 没有明确的先行词） → ✓ Many cities have banned cars from their centres. This policy has reduced both noise and air pollution.
- ✗ Teenagers spend hours on social media every night. It makes them anxious. → ✓ Teenagers spend hours on social media every night. This habit can make them anxious.
- ✗ Some countries offer free tuition. These policy attracts many students. → ✓ Some countries offer free tuition. Such policies attract many students.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 中文常用“这”泛指前文，英文就单独用 It 或含义模糊的 This 开头，读者不知道指什么。
2. 指代词与名词或动词单复数不一致（this problems, these method, such policy attract）。
3. 不敢用代词或同义词，一段里同一个名词重复五六次。

**自查方法**
给每个 it / they / this / such 画一条箭头指向它所指的词：指不出来、可能指两个词，或单复数不一致，就改成“this / these + 概括名词”或直接重复名词。

**补充**
- such 的结构：such + a/an + 单数可数名词，such + 复数名词或不可数名词；冠词放在 such 后面。✗ Such scheme is expensive. / ✗ A such scheme is expensive. → ✓ Such a scheme is expensive. / ✓ Such schemes are expensive.
- Which 不能在句号后独立开头去回指前一句，否则会变成句子碎片。✗ The city has made buses free for students. Which encourages young people to leave their cars at home. → ✓ The city has made buses free for students, which encourages young people to leave their cars at home. / ✓ The city has made buses free for students. This policy encourages young people to leave their cars at home.
- 读者通常把代词理解为离它最近或作主语的、单复数一致的名词；the former 指前者，the latter 指后者，不要用反。✗ Many travellers prefer trains to planes, even though they are slower.（they 最近的是 planes，读者会以为飞机更慢）→ ✓ Many travellers prefer trains to planes, even though trains are slower.
- 更多概括名词：研究结果用 finding / result / evidence，别人的说法用 argument / view / claim，变化用 trend / increase / shift，决定用 decision；不要把 problem、thing 当万能词。✗ Some critics claim that online exams make cheating easy. This problem overlooks modern monitoring software. → ✓ This claim overlooks modern monitoring software.
- 上位词替换要选对类别：smartwatches → these devices（✓），而不是 these phones（✗）；cashiers → these employees（✓）。替换后再检查一遍：附近有没有其他复数名词，会让 they 或“these + 名词”指错对象。
- 名词化回指：把前一句的动词变成名词来回指，衔接更紧密、更学术。✓ The government decided to raise the minimum wage. This decision was welcomed by most workers.（decide → this decision；argue → this argument；reduce → this reduction）
- 排序 / 自查：含“this / such + 名词”、代词、For this reason 的句子一定排在它所指内容之后；没有任何指代、概括全段话题的句子通常放在段首。
topic_sentence:
**规则**
主题句（topic sentence）通常是主体段的第一句，用一句话提出本段的中心论点：话题 + 观点（controlling idea）。好的主题句：
1. 是可论证的观点，而不是事实、数据或个人经历；
2. 范围适中：不宽到覆盖整篇文章，也不窄到只是一个细节；
3. 只有一个中心；
4. 用新的措辞回扣 thesis 中对应的分论点。
段内其余句子都用来解释、举例、证明这一句。

**例子**
- ✗ In 2020, millions of Chinese students took online classes.（事实） → ✓ Online learning can make high-quality education accessible to students in remote areas.
- ✗ Technology has many advantages and disadvantages.（太宽） → ✓ Smartphones can seriously distract students during lessons.
- ✗ Firstly, I will talk about the environment.（宣布式） → ✓ Firstly, banning private cars from city centres would significantly improve air quality.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 用 Firstly, let me talk about... 之类宣布式开头，没有说出观点。
2. 受“先分后总”习惯影响，先讲例子，把观点放在段末甚至不写。
3. 主题句太宽，或一句里塞进两三个观点。

**自查方法**
只读每个主体段的第一句：连起来是否像一份提纲，并且每句都在回答 thesis 的“为什么”？如果读者读完会问“So what?（那又怎样？）”，说明它只是事实，不是主题句。

**补充**
- **设问句不是主题句**：主题句要给出答案，不是提出问题。✗ Why are more and more young people renting rather than buying a home? → ✓ Many young people rent because house prices have risen much faster than wages.
- **看似学术的预告也是宣布式**：✗ The following paragraph will examine the effects of noise on health. / ✗ It is worth discussing how noise affects health. → ✓ Constant traffic noise can seriously disturb people's sleep.
- **“万能开头”属于范围过宽**：✗ With the development of society, people's lives have changed a lot. → ✓ Mobile payment has made everyday shopping faster and more convenient.
- **句中举出几个领域，不等于范围窄或有多个中心**：from banking to transport 这类列举只是说明范围有多广。判断主题句的宽窄，要看它要求证明的内容与支撑句实际写的内容是否一致。
- **主题句是对读者的“承诺”**：说了几个中心，段内就要证明几个；支撑句没有展开的内容不要写进主题句。✗ Online games waste students' time and also cost parents a lot of money.（全段只写浪费时间） → ✓ Online games can take up time that students need for homework and sleep.
  注意：判断是否“多中心”，看的是有几个不同的观点，而不是句中有没有 and。the time and energy of a daily commute 仍然只有一个中心。
- **数据、事实放在主题句之后**：它们可以紧跟在主题句后面作证据，但主题句的主干必须是观点。✗ A recent survey found that many students skip breakfast. → ✓ Skipping breakfast can harm students' concentration in morning lessons.
- **观点要在段首说清楚**：段末一句含糊的 Perhaps we should think about this. 代替不了主题句；应把明确的观点写在段首，例子放在后面作证据。
- **每个主题句对应 thesis 的一个分论点**：立场要一致、措辞要换新；不要整句照抄 thesis，也不要临时加进 thesis 中没有、或与其核心主张无关的理由。
unity:
**规则**
段落一致性（unity）指一段只围绕主题句的一个中心观点（controlling idea）展开：每一句都必须直接解释、证明或举例说明这个观点。注意“话题相同”不等于“观点一致”，下列句子都应删除或移到其他段落：
- 只与话题沾边的背景知识或题外话；
- 支持全文立场、但属于另一个分论点的句子；
- 与本段方向相反、又没有被处理的观点；
- 段末空洞的口号。

**例子**
主题句：Remote work can reduce employees' stress.
- ✗ Many companies now use video-calling software such as Zoom.（只讲工具，不支持“减压”） → ✓ Without a daily commute, employees have more time to rest.
主题句：Fast food contributes to childhood obesity.
- ✗ Fast food restaurants also create many jobs for young people.（另一话题） → ✓ A typical fast food meal contains far more calories than a child needs.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 想到什么写什么，在讲优点的段落中顺便加入缺点或“相关知识”。
2. 段末加“So we should protect our earth together!”之类与本段无关的口号。
3. 一段同时讲两三个论点，每个都没展开。

**自查方法**
逐句问：“这句话在帮主题句证明什么？”如果答不上来，或答案是另一个观点（即使它也支持全文立场），就删掉或挪到别的段落。

**补充**
- **链式偏题**：每句话都和上一句有联系，但整段越写越远。检查时要拿每一句对照主题句，而不只是对照上一句；一旦开始偏离，后面的句子通常要一起删除或重写。主题句：Part-time jobs teach students to manage their time. ✗ Many students work in coffee shops. Coffee shops in city centres have become very expensive.（逐句联想，已离开“时间管理”）
- **让步 + 反驳不破坏一致性**：相反观点只要被回应并拉回本段中心，就可以保留。主题句：Video games can improve teenagers' problem-solving skills. ✓ Admittedly, some games involve little more than fighting; however, many popular titles require players to plan several steps ahead.（承认局限后立刻回到本段观点） ✗ Some games are also very expensive to buy.（只抛出缺点，不回应）
- **“凡事有两面”不是辩证**：✗ Every coin has two sides, and electric cars also have some disadvantages.（在段末抛出相反观点却不处理，只会让段落中心变模糊）
- **结尾句要回扣 controlling idea**：结尾句应概括本段理由，不能引入新论点、新问题或口号。主题句：Learning to swim is an essential safety skill for children. ✗ Life is precious, so let us all cherish it! → ✓ In short, a child who can swim is far more likely to survive an accident in the water.
- **看起来有用的事实也可能跑题**：真实、具体的信息（如价格、历史、技术细节）如果不能证明主题句的观点，同样要删除；判断标准不是“是否正确”，而是“是否在证明本段中心”。
para_closing:
**规则**
段落最后一句（concluding sentence）负责“收”，常见两种写法：
1. 回扣型：用新的措辞概括本段观点，并点明它对 thesis 的意义（so what?），常用 Therefore / Thus / In this way / Clearly。
2. 过渡型：先用 these + 概括名词回指本段，再用转折或递进信号预告下一段的话题（只点到，不展开）。
结尾句不能：原样重复主题句；引入新论点或新例子；喊空洞口号；在主体段使用 In conclusion。

**例子**
主题句：Public parks improve residents' mental health.
- ✗ Therefore, public parks improve residents' mental health.（原样重复） → ✓ Clearly, green spaces are not a luxury but an essential part of a healthy city.
- ✗ Also, parks can attract tourists.（新论点） → ✓ In this way, parks help city dwellers recover from the stress of urban life.
- ✗ So let us all go to the park more often!（口号） → ✓ Cities that cut park budgets may therefore pay a hidden price in public health.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 段末用 In a word / All in all 加主题句原文，机械重复。
2. 段末抒情或喊口号（Let's protect our environment together!）。
3. 段末突然加一个新观点，读者以为段落还没写完。

**自查方法**
读完结尾句问两个问题：①它是否用新词说明了“本段证明了什么、为什么重要”？②它是否包含本段没讨论过的新信息？如果只是重复或带入新内容，就重写。

**补充**
- **As I said before / As mentioned above / To sum up + 主题句原文** 同样属于机械重复；只换开头词或调换词序也不算总结。
- 结尾句不添加本段没讨论过的任何内容，即使是**同方向**的新好处、新坏处、新研究或新例子也不行（“同样是坏处”不等于“同一个论点”）。✗（讲“早睡提高注意力”的段落末尾）Sleeping early is also good for the skin. → ✓ A regular bedtime, then, is one of the simplest ways to stay alert during the day.
- 点明意义时，结论强度要与本段证据相称：避免 completely / put an end to / the only way 等绝对化说法，多用 could / may / help to。✗ This proves that online learning will completely replace schools. → ✓ Online learning could therefore become a valuable addition to traditional schooling.
- 连回 thesis ≠ 引入新观点：只要结尾句的内容已在本段或 thesis 中出现，它就是在回答 so what。✓（thesis：政府应资助社区体育设施；本段：运动减少看病开支）Funding local sports facilities could therefore save public money in the long run.
- 过渡句的方向要与下一段一致：下一段讲另一个好处，用递进（Beyond these benefits... / In addition to...）；下一段讲缺点或代价，才用 However / Yet。过渡句只点到下一段的话题，不提前列出它的具体论据。✗（下一段讲图书馆的社交作用）However, libraries are also meeting places. → ✓ Beyond lending books, libraries also serve as important meeting places for local residents.
- 让步-反驳段的结尾必须回到作者立场，不能停在反方观点上，也不能写“各有利弊、因人而异”；可用 Far from... / rather than... / not... but... 把反方担忧“翻转”过来。✗ So whether screens are good or bad depends on each family. → ✓ The real problem, then, is how screens are used, not whether children use them at all.
prompt_analysis:
**规则**
动笔前把题目拆成三层：① **话题**（topic，大范围，如 technology）；② **焦点/限制词**（limiting words，如 *young people*、*in developing countries*、*only*、*the main reason*），它们把话题缩小到题目真正要讨论的范围；③ **指令词**（task words，如 *To what extent do you agree*、*Discuss both views*、*What are the causes*），它们决定你要“做什么”。每个主体段都必须同时扣住焦点并完成指令。忽略任何一个限制词，都会造成“部分跑题”。

**例子**
题目：Some people think that **children** should **not** be allowed to use **smartphones at school**. Do you agree or disagree?
- ✗ Smartphones help adults work more efficiently.（丢掉了 children 和 at school）
- ✓ Allowing pupils to keep their phones in class distracts them from lessons.

题目：What are the **causes** of traffic congestion?
- ✗ Traffic jams make people late for work.（写成了影响 effects）
- ✓ One major cause of congestion is the rapid rise in private car ownership.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 只看大话题，一见 technology 就套背好的“科技利弊”模板。
2. 把 causes 写成 effects，把 solutions 写成 problems。
3. 忽视 only、main、young people、in your country 等限制词。

**自查方法**
读题时圈出话题，划出限制词，框出指令词。写完每个主体段的主题句后问自己：这句话里有题目的焦点吗？它在完成指令吗？

**补充**
- **一题多问要全部回答**：题目里有几个问句或祈使句（Why...? / What can be done...? / Suggest some measures... / give your own opinion），就有几项任务，论点句和主体段必须逐一覆盖。题目：Why do many people move abroad for work? Is this a positive trend? ✗ This essay will explain why people move abroad for work.（漏掉第二问）✓ This essay will explain why people move abroad for work and argue that this trend is largely positive.
- **权衡题必须下结论**：Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? / Is this a positive or negative development? 要求比较轻重并明确表态，不能只“列出利弊”。题目：Do the advantages of living in a big city outweigh the disadvantages? ✗ This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city. ✓ Although big cities are noisy and expensive, the jobs and services they offer clearly outweigh these drawbacks.
- **最高级与比较类限制词要求“排序”**：the most important / the main reason / mainly X rather than Y 要求你比较或判断主次，只说“X 很重要”或“X 有害”等于丢掉了焦点。题目：Is exercise the most important factor in staying healthy? ✗ Exercise is important for good health. ✓ While exercise matters, I believe a balanced diet is a more important factor in staying healthy.
- **范围限制词不只是人群和地点**：还包括学段（in primary schools）、领域（reading and writing skills）、受益对象（for local residents / for the community）。论据必须来自这个范围。题目：Should primary school pupils learn a foreign language? ✗ Learning a foreign language helps university graduates find better jobs. ✓ Young children pick up the pronunciation of a new language more easily than adults do.
- **改写题目时题意不能变**：换词可以，但程度、语气、条件和范围都要保留：ban ≠ limit / encourage；should be done ≠ has been done；only after ≠ as well as；primary school pupils ≠ all students。题目：Fast-food restaurants should be banned near schools. ✗ Fast-food restaurants near schools should be encouraged to sell healthier food. ✓ Fast-food restaurants should not be permitted near schools.
question_types:
**规则**
先判断题型，再确定必须回应的部分：
- **Opinion**（Do you agree or disagree? / To what extent...?）：明确立场，全文一致。
- **Discuss both views and give your opinion**：两种观点都要讨论，并给出自己的观点。
- **Advantages and disadvantages**：利和弊都要写；如果问 *Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?*，必须判断哪一边更重。
- **Cause / Problem – Solution**：写原因（或问题），再写解决办法。
- **Positive or negative development?**：必须判断这一趋势总体是积极还是消极。
- **Two-part question**（两个直接问题）：两问都要回答，篇幅大致均衡。

**例子**
- ✗ (Discuss both views) The whole essay explains only why the writer supports view A.
- ✓ One body paragraph on view A, one on view B, with the writer's opinion clear in the introduction and conclusion.
- ✗ (Outweigh) There are both advantages and disadvantages.
- ✓ The benefits of online learning clearly outweigh its drawbacks.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 所有题目都写成“利弊＋总结”的万能结构。
2. 两问题只回答了第一问。
3. discuss both views 不给观点，误以为“保持中立”更安全。

**自查方法**
给题目中的每个问句或指令编号①②③，提纲里每一部分都要对应一个编号。交卷前逐一打勾。

**补充**
- **混合型两问题**：两个问句可能属于不同题型，要逐问判断。例如 Why...? ＋ Is this a positive or negative development?：第一问写原因，第二问必须给出总体判断。题目：Why are more people buying second-hand goods? Is this a positive or negative development?
  - ✗ Body 2: Buying second-hand goods has both advantages and disadvantages.
  - ✓ Body 2: On balance, this is a positive development, because it saves families money and reduces waste.
- **两问题要篇幅均衡**：第二问不能只在结尾补一句，应有独立的主体段展开。题目：Why are fewer people using public libraries? What can be done to change this?
  - ✗ Conclusion: ... Perhaps libraries could offer more activities.
  - ✓ Body 2: Libraries could attract more visitors by offering free Wi-Fi, quiet study spaces and evening events.
- **部分同意也是明确立场**：观点题可以 partly agree，但要说清同意哪部分、不同意哪部分；每个主体段都要支持 thesis，不能前后矛盾。题目：All cars should be banned from city centres.
  - ✗ I fully agree with a ban. ... Body 2: Shops in the city centre depend on customers who drive, so cars should still be allowed.
  - ✓ I partly agree: private cars should be banned from historic city centres, but buses, taxis and delivery vans should still be allowed.
- **Discuss both views 要真正展开另一方**：对方观点也要有完整的论述（通常一段），不能一句话带过就否定；开头和结尾的立场必须一致。
- **只回答题目问到的内容**：问 problems 就不要写 causes，没问办法就不必写建议段。题目：Many people spend several hours a day on their phones. What problems does this cause? What can be done about them?
  - ✗ Body 2: People use their phones so much mainly because apps are designed to be addictive.
  - ✓ Body 2: Families and schools could set phone-free times, such as during meals and lessons.
- **办法要对应原因**：原因—解决题中，每个办法最好针对前面的一个原因，避免“多建医院”“政府加强管理”之类的万能办法。题目：Why do many adults get too little exercise? What can be done about it?
  - ✗ Causes: long working hours, expensive gyms → Solution: The government should build more hospitals.
  - ✓ Employers could offer flexible working hours, and councils could put free exercise equipment in public parks.
- **结论不能回避判断**：outweigh / positive or negative 题，结尾要重申总体判断，不能用 Only time will tell... 之类的话代替。可用 on balance, largely, overall 表达有让步的判断。题目：More people now have their shopping delivered to their homes. Is this a positive or negative development?
  - ✗ In conclusion, this trend has both good and bad effects, and only time will tell what will happen.
  - ✓ In conclusion, although home delivery is convenient, I believe it is a largely negative development for local high streets.
thesis:
**规则**
Thesis（论点句）通常是开头段的最后一两句，必须做到四点：① **回答题目**：立场或判断清楚；② **可辩论**：不是事实，也不是人人都同意的空话；③ **具体**：最好预告主要理由；④ **全文一致**：主体段为它服务，结尾不能改变或弱化立场。只写 “This essay will discuss...” 而不表态，那只是预告，不是论点。

**例子**
- ✗ Technology has both advantages and disadvantages.
- ✓ Although technology can isolate people, it has made education far more accessible, so its benefits outweigh its drawbacks.
- ✗ Many people drive cars in big cities.（事实，无法辩论）
- ✓ Big cities should charge drivers a congestion fee, because it would reduce traffic and help fund public transport.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 用“有利有弊”“见仁见智”回避表态。
2. 开头同意，结尾又写 both sides are reasonable，立场漂移。
3. 论点太空泛，如 Education is very important.

**自查方法**
把 thesis 单独拿给没看过题目的人，问三个问题：他能猜出题目吗？会有人反对它吗？能看出主要理由吗？三个答案都是“能”才合格。

**补充**
- **双问题题要两问都答**：Why...? / Is it positive or negative? / problems and solutions 这类题，thesis 要对每一问都给出简短答案，漏答一问＝只部分回答题目。题目：What causes traffic congestion in big cities, and how can it be reduced? ✗ Traffic congestion is caused mainly by rising car ownership.（只回答了原因，漏掉了办法）✓ Traffic congestion is caused mainly by rising car ownership, and it can be reduced by better bus networks and congestion charges.
- **Outweigh 题必须比较轻重**：只罗列优点，或只说“有利有弊”，都没有回答题目。✗ Electric cars have many advantages, such as low running costs. ✓ Although electric cars are expensive to buy, their low running costs and environmental benefits clearly outweigh this drawback.
- **Partly agree 要说清分寸**：部分同意是合法立场，但必须写明同意哪部分、保留哪部分。✗ I partly agree, because both sides have good points. ✓ I agree that zoos should focus on protecting endangered species, but I disagree that they should close to the public, because ticket sales fund this work.
- **“看情况”要写出条件**：只写 it depends 等于没有表态，要说明在什么条件下支持哪一方。✗ Whether children should have phones depends on the situation. ✓ Children under twelve should not have smartphones, although basic phones are useful for their safety.
- **宣告句不是观点**：In this essay, I am going to give my opinion... 和 This essay will discuss... 一样，只宣布要表态，并没有表态。
- **复述题目现象不是 thesis**：✗ Nowadays, more and more people take holidays abroad. ✓ The rise in overseas holidays is largely positive, because it broadens people's horizons and supports jobs in tourism.
- **主体段要为 thesis 服务**：每个主体段的主题句对应 thesis 中的一个理由；提到反方时用“让步＋反驳”，不能得出相反的结论。✗（thesis 支持征收糖税）However, a sugar tax makes food more expensive for poor families, so it should not be introduced. ✓ Although a sugar tax makes some products slightly more expensive, this cost is small compared with the long-term benefits to public health.
- **立场程度要与主体段匹配**：主体段里有条件或保留，thesis 就用 largely agree / provided that / only if，而不是 strongly agree。
introduction:
**规则**
议论文开头段一般 2–4 句：① **Hook / 引入**：一个与题目直接相关的现象、趋势或一般性陈述（不要编造精确数据）；② **背景**：用自己的话改写（paraphrase）题目，点出争议；③ **Thesis**：明确立场和主要理由。开头段不展开论证，也不放详细例子。避免能套在任何题目上的套话：*With the development of society...*、*Every coin has two sides.*、*Nowadays, more and more people...*

**例子**
- ✗ With the development of society, more and more people pay attention to this problem.
- ✓ In the past decade, online learning has moved from the edge of education into the mainstream.
- ✗ Every coin has two sides. Online learning has advantages and disadvantages.
- ✓ While some argue that screens can never replace classrooms, others see online courses as the future of education.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 背诵万能开头，换任何题目都能用。
2. 照抄题目原句。雅思中照抄的部分不计字数，也显得词汇贫乏。
3. 开头段太长，把理由和例子都提前写了进去。

**自查方法**
删掉第一句后，开头段几乎没有损失吗？如果是，说明它是套话。再看最后一句：它能单独作为 thesis 吗？

**补充**
- **其他空泛的 hook**：定义式（X is...）、“自古以来”式和“X 很重要”式开头同样离题目焦点太远；也不要编造精确数据。✗ Music is a kind of art that people enjoy. ✗ Since ancient times, people have made music for pleasure. ✓ Streaming services have made almost any song ever recorded available within seconds.
- **As we all know...** 和 Every coin has two sides 一样是套话。✗ As we all know, health is the most important thing in life. ✓ Many office workers now spend most of their waking hours sitting at a desk.
- **改写不能改变原意**：对象范围（advertising ≠ marketing ≠ all advertising）、程度（ban ≠ reduce/regulate）和双方观点都要保留，不能把 some people 写成 everyone。（题目：Some people think homework should be banned in primary schools.）✗ Everyone agrees that homework is useless. ✗ There is a debate about whether homework should be reduced. ✓ Opinion is divided on whether young pupils should be given any homework at all.
- **thesis 要回应题型**：“利是否大于弊”题要说明哪一方更重；Discuss both views 题要“表明会讨论双方 + 给出自己的观点”（观点可以有条件，但条件要具体）。只写 This essay will discuss...、写“有利也有弊”、用问句结尾或只强调问题很严重，都不算 thesis。✗ Working from home has both advantages and disadvantages. ✓ Although working from home can feel isolating, I believe its benefits for productivity and family life outweigh this drawback.
- **thesis 只简要点出主要理由（通常 2–3 个，与主体段数量一致）**，不放个人经历、研究结果或一长串理由。✗ I oppose school uniforms because my cousin's school spent a fortune on blazers last year. ✓ I oppose compulsory school uniforms because they limit self-expression and place a financial burden on families.
- **用衔接手段连接各句**：this/such + 名词、These problems、As a result、Some... Others, however... 让 hook → 背景 → thesis 自然推进；回指词必须放在被指代的内容之后。✓ Many young people now choose to study abroad. This trend has prompted debate about whether...
conclusion:
**规则**
结尾段一般 2–4 句：① 通常用 *In conclusion / To sum up / Overall* 等信号词开头，**换一种说法**重申 thesis，立场必须与开头一致；② 简要概括主体段的主要理由，不重复例子细节；③ 可以加一句“升华”：意义、建议或展望。**不引入新论据或新例子**，不改变或弱化立场，也不逐字照抄开头。

**例子**
- ✗ In conclusion, every coin has two sides.（立场消失）
- ✓ In conclusion, although online learning can be isolating, its flexibility makes it a valuable option for most adults.
- ✗ ... Another important reason is that it saves electricity.（结尾出现新论据）
- ✓ ... As internet access spreads, online courses could open higher education to millions of adults who cannot attend a campus.（升华：展望意义）

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 结尾突然冒出一个“更重要的理由”。
2. 怕说得太绝对，结尾改成“两边都有道理”。
3. 逐字复制开头的 thesis。

**自查方法**
标出结尾的每个观点，回到正文逐一查找：每一点都在主体段出现过吗？立场与 thesis 一致吗？措辞与开头不同吗？

**补充**
- **结尾信号词**：用 In conclusion / To conclude / To sum up / In summary / Overall 开头。At last＝“（经过等待）终于”；At the end 只表示时间或位置上的“末尾”（通常要接 of，如 at the end of the film），不表示“总之”；Lastly / Last but not least 只用来引出最后一个主体论点，不能开启结尾段。
  - ✗ At last, all children should learn to swim at primary school.
  - ✓ To conclude, all children should learn to swim at primary school.
- **只换一个词、调换语序、主动改被动都不算改写**：重申 thesis 要同时更换关键词和句式。
  - ✗ Governments should prohibit single-use plastic packaging, since it pollutes rivers and oceans...（只把 ban 换成 prohibit）
  - ✓ Throwaway plastic packaging should be outlawed, as it contaminates seas and rivers...
- **让步≠骑墙**：可以用 while / although 先承认反方，但主句必须回到自己的立场；“各有利弊”“因人而异”“很难说”都属于立场消失。
  - ✗ ..., so it is hard to say which is better. / ... should depend on each family's situation.
  - ✓ While care homes can provide expert medical care, most older people are better off living with their families.
- **总结理由，不复述例子**：人名、数字、故事留在主体段，结尾只写这些例子证明的理由。
  - ✗ My cousin, for example, spent three months at an advertising agency...
  - ✓ Internships equip students with practical workplace skills and help them make better-informed career choices.
- **升华要扣题**：不用万能口号或谚语，而是针对本文话题给出具体的建议、展望或意义。
  - ✗ Let us join hands and make the world a better place.
  - ✓ If more people learned basic repair skills, far fewer repairable goods would end up in landfill.
- **新论据、新证据可能“悄悄”出现**：不只是 Another reason / Moreover，用 also、What is more 带出的新好处，以及支持已有理由的新例子、新研究、新数据，同样不能放在结尾，应该写进相应的主体段。
  - ✗ ...they also improve a city's image as a welcoming place to visit.（正文从未提到城市形象）
  - ✗ Indeed, after cereal adverts aimed at children were taken off the air in one region, a local supermarket saw its sales of sugary cereals fall by a third.（支持已有理由的新证据）
organization:
**规则**
标准议论文结构是：**开头段**（引入＋thesis）→ **主体段 2–3 段**（一段只讲一个中心论点，顺序与 thesis 预告的理由一致）→ **结尾段**。discuss both views 题通常先写一方观点，再写另一方并表明自己的立场；让步和反驳可以单独成段。分段原则是一段一个功能，换中心就换段。段与段之间用 *Firstly / Another reason / On the other hand / In conclusion* 等信号词衔接，且各段内容不能重复。

**例子**
- ✗ Body 1: Cycling is cheap. It is also healthy, and it reduces pollution.（三个理由挤在一段）
- ✓ Body 1: cost → Body 2: health → Body 3: pollution（每个理由各成一段）
- ✗ Thesis: “...because it is cheaper and safer.” 之后 Body 1 讲 safety，Body 2 讲 cost
- ✓ Body 1 讲 cost，Body 2 讲 safety（与 thesis 预告的顺序一致）

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 全文不分段，或一段写到底。
2. 开头段就开始举例论证，开头和主体的功能混在一起。
3. 两个主体段其实在说同一件事，只是换了说法。

**自查方法**
只读每段第一句，连起来是不是全文提纲？每段能否用一个词概括功能（引入 / 理由1 / 理由2 / 让步 / 结论）？有没有两段用的是同一个词？

**补充**
- **开头段由宽到窄**：背景 → 引出问题或争议 → thesis（通常是开头段最后一句）；开头段不展开论证、不举具体例子。✗ 开头第一句就写 For example, my cousin plays games until midnight. ✓ Today, most students bring a smartphone to school. … In my opinion, such a ban is a good idea, because it helps students focus on their lessons.
- **结尾段只总结、不加新内容**：重申立场 → 概括主体段理由 →（可选）建议或展望；不出现新论点、新例子或开头式的大背景句。✗ In conclusion, video games can also make young people more aggressive.（新论点）✓ In conclusion, cutting down on gaming would help young people sleep better and do better at school.
- **thesis 是路线图**：预告的理由不多、不少，顺序与主体段一致；主体段可用回指体现顺序（Besides enjoying cleaner air... / Equally compelling is... / The last of these benefits...）。✗ thesis 预告三个理由，正文只写两个，或顺序颠倒 ✓ 预告几个理由就写几段，顺序相同。
- **按题型安排段落**：利弊题“利一组、弊一组”，用 However 转向；原因—解决题先写原因、再写办法；双问题题按提问顺序逐一回答，每个问题至少一段。✗ 题目问 Why is this happening? What can be done? 却写 Body 1: advantages → Body 2: disadvantages ✓ Body 1: reasons → Body 2: solutions
- **判断重复看核心论点，不看用词**：同一论点换同义词写成两段就是重复，应合并。✗ Body 1: ...spares firms the expense of recruiting and training replacements. / Body 4: ...avoid the cost of hiring and preparing newcomers. ✓ 合并为一段。而“省钱”和“传授经验”虽同属“对企业有价值”，分论点不同，可以各自成段。
- **分段时例子和结果跟着观点走**：例子、解释和由它引出的结果（As a result / Consequently...）要和它支持的观点放在同一段；不要因为出现一个新名词就切段，也不要因为“所有句子都支持 thesis”就把两个中心放在同一段。
- **让步反驳段的写法**：对方观点 → 承认合理之处 → However 反驳 → 补充理由 → 回到立场；它可以放在自己的论点之前或之后，但不能只让步不反驳，也不要把反方观点挪进结尾。✗ However, driverless cars could put many drivers out of work.（之后再无回应）✓ Although driverless cars could put many professional drivers out of work, this change is likely to be gradual, giving drivers time to retrain for new jobs.
planning:
**规则**
动笔前用约 5 分钟列提纲（雅思建议 Task 2 用时约 40 分钟）：① 圈出题目关键词，判断题型；② 写一句 thesis（立场＋理由）；③ 为每个主体段写一个中心论点，再加 1–2 个支撑关键词（解释或例子）；④ 检查四点：每段都回应题目，各段互不重复，各点属于同一层级（都是理由，而不是一个理由加一个例子），顺序与 thesis 一致。提纲用英文关键词或短语即可，不写完整段落。

**例子**
Prompt: Should university education be free?
- ✗ free — good. money. students.（无立场、无分段）
- ✓ Thesis: yes → fairer access + skilled workforce. B1: fairness — talented rural students. B2: economy — more engineers, nurses.
- ✗ B1: helps poor students. B2: poor students can afford it.（两段重复）
- ✓ B1: social fairness. B2: economic benefit.

**中国学生常见错误**
1. 怕时间不够而跳过提纲，写到一半没话说或跑题。
2. 用中文写成长段落提纲，耗时过长。
3. 列出的点互相重叠，或把例子当成独立论点。

**自查方法**
提纲写完问三个问题：thesis 回答题目了吗？每个点能独立撑起一段吗？任意两个点有没有重叠？

**补充**
- **按题型规划**：两问题（原因＋措施）每一问至少占一段，措施最好逐一回应原因；discuss both views 两种观点各一段，thesis 写明个人观点，自己支持的一方通常放在第二段；outweigh 题的 thesis 必须判断哪一方更重。✗ Thesis: this trend has both advantages and disadvantages. ✓ Thesis: the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
- **紧扣限定词**：圈出题目中限定对象、范围的词（如 primary school children、local communities），每个论点都必须针对它们；背好的“万能论点”要先核对受益对象。✗（题目问 local communities）Body: travelling broadens tourists' horizons. ✓ Body: tourism creates jobs for local residents.
- **隐蔽的重叠**：一个论点如果只是另一个论点换了标签，或者是它的直接结果，也算重复。✗ B1: convenience — no need to travel to shops. B2: time — no hours spent going from store to store. ✓ B1: convenience for shoppers. B2: new customers for small businesses.
- **兑现 thesis**：thesis 预告的每个理由都要有对应的主体段；partly agree 的两半都要论证。✗ Thesis: partly agree — prison deters, but education works better. B1: deterrence. B2: public safety. ✓ B2: education and job training — fewer offenders return to crime.
- **立场针对题目的说法**：题目本身含否定或判断（no longer relevant、a waste of time）时，先复述题目观点，再决定 agree 还是 disagree。✗（题目：festivals are no longer relevant）Thesis: agree — festivals still matter. ✓ Thesis: disagree — festivals still matter.
